definitions.explanation: Someone who has achieved mastery in a particular skill or art.

definitions.gloss: title holder (in games like shogi or go)
definitions.explanation: The holder of the highest title in traditional Japanese board games.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名人|めいじん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名人|めいじん}⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The shogi Meijin championship has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧{名人|めいじん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: I'm called a master of saving money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧⟦づくり→づくり：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名人|めいじん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother is an expert at making pickles and is well known in the neighborhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名人|めいじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棋士|きし}→棋士：27809_kishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A young player won the Meijin title this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名人|めいじん}⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The go Meijin championship is held every autumn.

notes:
Can refer to serious expertise or be used somewhat humorously for everyday skills.

TYPES OF {名人|めいじん}:
- ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧{名人|めいじん} (shogi master/title holder)
- ⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧{名人|めいじん} (go master/title holder)
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧{名人|めいじん} (master chef)
- ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧{名人|めいじん} (expert at saving money)
- ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧{名人|めいじん} (expert at making excuses)

TITLE USAGE:
In ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧ and ⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧, {名人|めいじん} is one of the highest titles, earned through championship tournaments.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{達人|たつじん}→達人：14378_tatsujin⟧ (master, expert)
- ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧ (specialist)
